title: Mull
summary: MULL, verb transitive [Latin mollio, to soften.] 1. To soften; or to heat, sweeten and enrich with spices; as, to mull wine. Drink new cider, mull'd with ginger warm. 2. To dispirit or deaden. MULL, n

inlines.v: MULL, verb transitive [Latin mollio, to soften.] 1. To soften; or to heat, sweeten and enrich with spices; as, to mull wine. Drink new cider, mull'd with ginger warm. 2. To dispirit or deaden. MULL, noun In Scottish, a snuff-box, made of the small end of a horn. MULL, noun Dust. [Not in use.]
